messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: High traffic imbalance detected for eu-west region (influx to economy lane). Impacting p50/p95 latency for tier-economy customers. Root thread ts 2067894321

emma_oncall: paging. I’m on it, looking at the console now. @sam_sre can you join? 

sam_sre: on call, joining. seeing a rise in queued requests on economy pools across eu-west-1, CPU saturation ~88% and token latencies spiking. 

kai: adding context — large burst from one customer bundle (client-id: c-8a3f). Not seeing model errors, just higher queue times. 

maria_prod: confirming elevated errors? metrics show error rate stable; it's latency/backpressure, not model failures. Customers complaining about slow responses for embeddings and chat. 

emma_oncall: initial mitigation idea: temporarily rebalance smart-routing weights to reduce load on economy lane in eu-west and bump up latency-priority pool for top-tier customers. Also consider per-customer token rate cap for c-8a3f. Thoughts? 

sam_sre: agree. sequence: 1) quick reduce economy weight by 40% for eu-west 2) increase latency lane capacity (enable burst from dedicated pool) 3) apply 5% rate-limit reduction for offending client 4) monitor 10 min canary. 

jessops: ready to execute config changes. prepping patch. 

prod-alerts-bot: Auto: route-weight-anomaly detected. Suggested mitigation template: change-route-weights -> apply-rate-cap -> notify-customer. 

emma_oncall: jessops, run the route change first. Provide the exact config you’ll apply in-thread. 

jessops: applying now. patch:
```json
{
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "routing": {
    "economy": {"weight": 0.6},
    "standard": {"weight": 1.0},
    "latency": {"weight": 1.4}
  },
  "effective_immediately": true
}
```
Executing CLI: redwoodctl routing update --region eu-west-1 --patch-file patch.json

jessops: done. change applied at 2067894385. 

sam_sre: seeing immediate drop in incoming queuing for economy pools. p95 latency for economy down ~18% in first 30s. marking as in-progress mitigation. 

kai: pushing a temporary per-tenant token cap for c-8a3f: redwoodctl quotas set --tenant c-8a3f --region eu-west-1 --tps 12 --burst 30

prod-alerts-bot: Quota change applied for tenant c-8a3f. 

maria_prod: customer-facing note: internal ops - working on throttling a noisy tenant; no data loss. If asked, we’ll mention temporary reduced throughput for non-critical workloads. 

emma_oncall: good. also enable selective feature disable: turn off economy-tier 'async-embeddings-batch-combine' optimization in eu-west to reduce load variance. jessops can you flip that flag? 

jessops: toggling flag via infra toggle service: toggle set --env prod --key async-embeddings-batch-combine --region eu-west-1 --value false

jessops: flag off at 2067894430. 

sam_sre: metrics update at +3m: queue depth continuing to decline, latency stabilizing. No new error spikes. 

kai: monitoring downstream KPIs: cost spike receding, request distribution shifting to latency lane as expected. 

emma_oncall: start a 10-minute canary. If stable, we'll leave route weights for 30m then gradually restore. Anyone object to leaving tenant cap in place for 1 hour? 

maria_prod: fine. I'll prepare a brief customer comms for affected enterprise contacts (and a PS to support to reference internal incident id: INC-206789). 

sam_sre: adding a short postmortem note in incidents later. For now – continue monitoring. 

prod-alerts-bot: Monitor: p95 latency eu-west-1 economy 380ms -> 310ms (after changes). p50 stable. 

emma_oncall: :thumbsup: thanks team. leaving channel but will check back at 2067894721 for status. 

sam_sre: will stay on until canary completes. 

kai: logging the commands executed in runbook:
- redwoodctl routing update --region eu-west-1 --patch-file patch.json
- redwoodctl quotas set --tenant c-8a3f --region eu-west-1 --tps 12 --burst 30
- toggle set --env prod --key async-embeddings-batch-combine --region eu-west-1 --value false

jessops: once canary passes, I'll schedule gradual rollback: economy weight +15% every 10m over 30m. 

prod-alerts-bot: Canary complete. p95 in economy lane holding at ~315ms for 10m. No error uptick. 

sam_sre: marking incident mitigated, leaving notes for postmortem. 

emma_oncall: closing handoff. follow-up: run a short eval on routing policy to see if the economy heuristics need to be adjusted (client-based smoothing) and add a customer-specific circuit-breaker for heavy tenants. 

maria_prod: acknowledged. will open a follow-up ticket for product and infra.
